title: HOW did 13th-century metallurgists forge 30-foot iron beams that never rust? #Shorts
description:
HOW did 13th-century metallurgists forge 30-foot iron beams that never rust?

The lintels of Konark were supported by forge-welded wrought iron beams up to 10 meters long and weighing tons, exposed to humid, saline Bay of Bengal sea air for 800 years with near-zero corrosion due to high phosphorus content and slag-layer passivation.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
